self_sha256_note: This preregistration JSON deliberately does NOT embed its own SHA256 to avoid a self-reference paradox. The external SHA256 is recorded by the run report and the harness result JSON.
preregistered_before_metrics: This file is written before any new validation NPZ is read for this experiment.

harness_prompt.note: verbatim harness prompt saved before any validation NPZ read

research_question: Without changing the frozen prompt_mean_vector hardware structure, does a fixed-weight (1.0) same-image wrong-prompt softplus contrastive term added to the spatial KL base loss make the student learn the same-image other-task prompt discrimination (prior spatial-student G2) while preserving the positive deployed retained-mass utility?

prior_negative_result.known_historical_defect: the prior report's B_selector_minus_L2_anchor_mass_k48 aggregation used base - metric; the correct sign is selector - l2_anchor. This experiment computes P5 as selector - baseline only and never edits the prior report or trainer.
prior_negative_result.failed_gate: G2 prompt sensitivity (same-image other-task) was the only failing gate in the prior spatial-student experiment

existing_spatial_trainer.note: read-only reuse source; must remain byte-for-byte unchanged and must not be edited by this experiment

frozen_spatial_targets.grounding_area_target: exact bbox/grid-cell intersection area normalized to sum 1 (grounding)
frozen_spatial_targets.pointing_bilinear_target: separable bilinear point mass over up to four neighboring centers, normalized to sum 1 (pointing)

split_rule.test_npz_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored; no test path is built from the index in this experiment

arms.name: A_SPATIAL_KL_CONTROL
arms.target: spatial (grounding area target / pointing bilinear target)

arms.name: B_SPATIAL_KL_CONTRASTIVE
arms.target: spatial (grounding area target / pointing bilinear target)

loss_definition.wrong_prompt_definition: grounding record uses the same image pointing prompt; pointing record uses the same image grounding prompt; each KL still uses the record's own spatial target

optimization.model_selection: arm A best by its own val base; arm B best by its own val total; tie earliest epoch

validation_metrics.same_image_other_task_control: correct minus wrong prompt for spatial Spearman and full NDCG
validation_metrics.cross_image_same_task_derangement: descriptive deterministic derangement, same task donor, no self-pair, donor seed 20261103
validation_metrics.deployed_selection_proxy: combine_scores (lambda_semantic from hardware config) + exact select_real_groups 3x3 anchor rule; compare B retained spatial-target mass vs L2+anchor baseline at K48

statistics.seed_aggregation: per-image median delta across seeds then image-level paired effect
holm_family: P1 B minus A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap
P2 B minus A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap
P3 B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap
P4 B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap
P5 B deployed selector minus L2+anchor retained spatial-target mass at K48 (selector minus baseline)
statistics.primary_metric_policy: only these five tests decide the result; other metrics are descriptive
statistics.p5_sign_rule: per-image delta = selector_mass_k48 - l2_anchor_mass_k48; the reverse sign is forbidden and unit-tested

gates.G1_correct_alignment_non_inferiority: both B-A correct spatial Spearman/NDCG deltas: mean >= -0.02, 95% CI lower >= -0.05, and >= 2/3 seed means >= -0.02 (descriptive non-inferiority, not in Holm)
gates.G2_prompt_discrimination_gain: P1 and P2 both: mean>0, CI lower>0, |dz|>=0.2, Holm p<0.05, positive in >=2/3 seeds
gates.G3_prompt_discrimination_absolute: P3 and P4 both: mean>0, CI lower>0, |dz|>=0.2, Holm p<0.05, positive in >=2/3 seeds
gates.G4_deployed_K48_utility: P5: mean>0, CI lower>0, |dz|>=0.2, Holm p<0.05, positive in >=2/3 seeds
gates.G5_collapse_removed: exact prompt-score invariance fraction <= 0.05 in every arm B seed
gates.G6_validation_learning: >=2/3 arm B seeds have best_epoch>0 and best val total < epoch0 val total
gates.G7_hardware_contract: query [1,128], FPGA Gx128 dot, no token-axis max/softmax/exp, existing fixed-budget 3x3 anchor selection

decision_rule.control_rule: A is a control and can never win

development_validation_note: the existing val split has already been used for development; this experiment is development validation only and must not be presented as final accuracy
prohibitions: no third arm and no arm target substitution
no contrastive weight, margin or softplus temperature tuning
no target blending, rank loss, auxiliary loss or hyperparameter search
no internal test NPZ read or evaluation
no 4B model load, no feature re-extraction, no raw image read, no GPU, no network, no package installation
no modification of evaluation/train_spatial_prompt_selector.py or any existing report
no post-hoc change of the five-test Holm family, gates, decision rule or corrected selected-set NDCG helper
no claim of final accuracy, CV-Bench task accuracy, hardware speedup or board deployment
change_policy: After the first validation NPZ read for this experiment, this preregistration and the preregistered config are frozen byte-for-byte; the run must prove both are unchanged.
authorization: DeepSeek Harness may process necessary code, metrics and derived data via api.deepseek.com; raw images, 4B weights, keys, proxy config and credentials are never read, uploaded or printed.
